title: Bills of Lading and Transport Documents: Number of Documents a Customer May Hold
content:
Under `Bills of Lading and Transport Documents`, the company places no ceiling on how many transport documents one customer holds at the same time. A documentation party may therefore have any number of live documents on the records of Aurelia Hanse Line, whatever their types and statuses.

## Clause

1. There is no maximum number of transport documents per customer; the limit is not set to any figure.
2. Every transport document relates to one booking and to one booking only.
3. How several documents may coexist on the same booking is a separate matter, decided by the booking-level rule on documents in force, and is not affected by this clause.

## Quick reference

| Question | Answer |
|---|---|
| Cap on documents held by one customer | None |
| Bookings covered by one document | Exactly one |

## Points of judgement

**A forwarder already holds forty issued documents and submits shipping instructions for a new booking. Does the size of its portfolio matter?** No. The count of documents the customer holds is never a ground for refusing a new document.

**Can one document be drafted to cover two bookings together?** No. Each document is tied to a single booking.
